title: Needs decision: the second head is absent from formal validation candidates
detail: The delivery-gate parser recognizes only fd1caa475f85483cf5c4031a1e58656ff5d3eaff. The checklist explicitly authorizes validating fa485f008562f00ebf91deed19e58ea52bb4b4dc, but it is not a header Candidate line. ADR 0036 and delivery_gate.py require that line before a sibling can supply ADR 0076. FO owns the dispatch record and any later rebase validation.
fix: FO records the sibling as a formal Candidate in the latest validation dispatch and arranges a recheck of any rebased head before a merge ask.
